facts.text: Viterbo guarantees four-year graduation for participating undergraduates, offering course waivers, substitutions, or a tuition-free semester if required courses are unavailable.

sources.title: Four-Year Degree Information - Viterbo University
sources.quote: If a student who complies with the terms of the guarantee is unable to graduate within four years, Viterbo will allow them to graduate by either substituting a different course, waiving a course, or not charging tuition
